books.name: 1 Clement
books.author: Clement of Rome
books.desc: Epistle from the church of Rome to the church of Corinth on peace, harmony, and order.

books.name: 2 Clement
books.author: Anonymous (Early Preacher)
books.desc: The earliest surviving Christian sermon outside the New Testament, focusing on repentance and holiness.

books.name: Ignatius to Ephesians
books.author: Ignatius of Antioch
books.desc: Exhortation to church unity, steadfast faith in Jesus Christ, and harmony under the bishop.

books.name: Ignatius to Magnesians
books.author: Ignatius of Antioch
books.desc: Treatise on living according to Christian grace rather than Jewish rituals, emphasizing the Resurrection.

books.name: Ignatius to Trallians
books.author: Ignatius of Antioch
books.desc: Warning against docetic heresies, affirming the true physical birth, suffering, and resurrection of Christ.

books.name: Ignatius to Romans
books.author: Ignatius of Antioch
books.desc: Passionate plea not to hinder his impending martyrdom in Rome, desiring to be pure wheat ground for Christ.

books.name: Ignatius to Philadelphians
books.author: Ignatius of Antioch
books.desc: Call to unity in the one Eucharist and bishop, refuting factionalism and Judaizing tendencies.

books.name: Ignatius to Smyrnaeans
books.author: Ignatius of Antioch
books.desc: Defense of Christ's real flesh and the Eucharist, giving early testimony of the Catholic (universal) Church.

books.name: Ignatius to Polycarp
books.author: Ignatius of Antioch
books.desc: Pastoral counsel to Polycarp, bishop of Smyrna, on loving care, patience, widows, and church discipline.

books.name: Polycarp to Philippians
books.author: Polycarp of Smyrna
books.desc: Pastoral epistle saturated with quotations from Pauline epistles, 1 Peter, and the Gospels.

books.name: Didache
books.author: Anonymous (Teaching of the Twelve Apostles)
books.desc: Early church manual describing the Two Ways (Life and Death), baptism, fasting, prayer, Eucharist, and ministry.

books.name: Epistle of Barnabas
books.author: Pseudo-Barnabas (Alexandria)
books.desc: Typological and allegorical reading of the Old Testament covenant, sacrificial laws, and the Two Ways.

books.name: Shepherd of Hermas
books.author: Hermas of Rome
books.desc: Extensive apocalyptic work of 5 Visions, 12 Mandates, and 10 Similitudes on post-baptismal penance.

books.name: Martyrdom of Polycarp
books.author: Church of Smyrna
books.desc: Account of the trial and heroic martyrdom of aged bishop Polycarp, structured like the passion of Christ.

books.name: Epistle to Diognetus
books.author: Anonymous Apologist
books.desc: Eloquence on Christian identity: 'What the soul is in the body, that the Christians are in the world.'
